summary: Frontend testing of iteration 21 features: 3 new US calculators (FIRE, Student Loan, Self-Employment Tax), US Onboarding Wizard, Landing Page US-aware copy, Dashboard 9-calculator US section. All core features working correctly.

Final CTA section (line ~971) also shows hardcoded 'R299/month or R1,999/year' in US mode.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features working. Bugs are in LandingPage.jsx content that doesn't adapt to US jurisdiction: (1) Pricing section hardcoded R299 instead of $19, (2) About/Features/Footer sections contain SA-only text visible in US mode. FIRE/StudentLoan/SelfEmployed calculators fully functional. Wizard localStorage key is 'us_onboarding_completed'. SE Tax note: displays $12,010 for $100k income/$15k expenses (test description says ~$12,300 but $12,010 is the correct IRS calculation).

landing_page_us_headline.details: US mode shows 'The Complete Financial Planning Platform for Americans' with correct stats: 30+ Financial Tools, All 50 States Covered, FIRE Retirement Planning, PDF. Badge: '2024/2025 Tax Year · All 50 States'. Hero price: $19/month or $199/year.

landing_page_sa_mode.details: SA mode shows 'South Africans' in headline and R299/month pricing visible

landing_page_us_pricing_section_bug.details: The dedicated pricing section further down the page still shows hardcoded R299/month in US mode. Hero section correctly shows $19/month. This is a content consistency bug.

us_onboarding_wizard_appears.details: Wizard appears automatically ~800ms after login when jurisdiction=US and localStorage 'us_onboarding_completed' is not set. Shows 'US Setup · 1/5' badge.

us_onboarding_wizard_5_steps.details: All 5 steps navigable: Step1=Welcome+State+FilingStatus, Step2=Income+Employment, Step3=RetirementAccounts, Step4=Goals, Step5=PersonalizedToolkit. All data-testid selectors working.

us_onboarding_wizard_completion_persiste.details: After completing wizard, 'us_onboarding_completed'='true' is stored in localStorage. On next visit, wizard does NOT appear.

fire_calculator_loads.details: Loads with all 4 variants: Lean FIRE, Regular FIRE, Fat FIRE, Barista FIRE. Has sliders (Expected Return, Inflation Rate), AreaChart with Portfolio vs FIRE Number line, Coast FIRE calculations.

fire_calculator_calculation.details: With $120k income, $60k expenses: Regular FIRE Number = $1,500,000 ($60k × 25 = $1.5M) CORRECT. Lean=$900k, Fat=$2.25M, Barista=$750k all correct per formula.

student_loan_calculator_loads.details: Loads with all 5 strategies: Standard 10yr ($397/mo), Extended 25yr ($236/mo), IBR/SAVE ($135/mo), Extra Payments ($597/mo), Refinanced ($363/mo). Best Strategy banner shows Extra Payments. Two charts: Total Interest Comparison + Balance Over Time.

self_employed_tax_loads.details: Loads with income/deductions form. Default $100k income, $15k expenses shows: Net Profit=$85k, SE Tax=$12,010, Total Tax=$19,285, Take-Home=$65,715, Effective Rate=19.3%.

self_employed_tax_calculation.details: SE Tax=$12,010 (correct per IRS formula: $85k × 0.9235 × 0.153 = $12,010). Test description said ~$12,300 but actual calculation is $12,010. QBI Deduction=$12,599 available and visible. W-2 comparison chart shown.

dashboard_us_new_calculators.details: Dashboard US mode shows: FIRE Calculator, Student Loan Payoff, Self-Employment Tax cards (all 9 total US calculators). All 3 new calculators have 'NEW' badge and proper descriptions/features.

dashboard_us_section_ordering.details: US Tax & Retirement section appears BEFORE Debt & Loan Calculators section. Correct ordering confirmed.
